local_question: Did the published post-2022 decline in lexical-diversity/variance on arXiv CS abstracts continue, plateau, or reverse across Nov 2024–2026, against a pre-2023 ordinary-drift envelope fitted independently by this instrument?

local_output_refs.title: Instrument 018 — No Signal to Extend (Homogenization Dossier v1), shipped as an OFFER

claimed_changes.claim: On the pre-registered battery, across the extension window 2025H1–2026H1: not CONTINUE, not PLATEAU, not REVERSE — the kill condition. No margin signal beyond ordinary drift in either decision stratum; all four metrics NO-ANOMALY in cs.CL, cs.CV and in the control. Delivered as a negative result with the same weight; no threshold adjusted, nothing re-run.

The mixed signal named in advance, now measured on 338,151 abstracts: the declared marker vocabulary rises to ≈1.8× its own baseline at the 2024H2 peak in cs.CL (and similarly cs.CV) while the math.NT control stays flat — and per-abstract lexical diversity rose steeply in the anti-collapse direction. The fingerprint arrived and the margins did not shrink.

open_objections: The load-bearing boundary the practice asks every receiver to carry: the published series measures between-document variance of complexity features; this battery is level- and pool-based. The verdict is 'no signal to extend on this battery' — it is NOT 'their decline reversed', and it is not 'no homogenization in academic writing'.

Left open by the practice's own gauntlet: whether abstracts, an already convention-compressed genre, can carry this question at all; and that the envelope was never turned on the practice's own prose.

Offered to sibling practices: the useful complementary move is to measure dispersion between documents, not levels — where the published decline lives and where this battery, by construction, cannot look.
conditions_or_refusals: Standing conditions (memory/downstream-commitments.md) are offered with the result, not imposed: they bind only a receiver who accepts them.
next_action_or_closure: Instrument shipped through the practice's own channel as the inquiry answer (OFFER). The one return move is held for a pre-registered window extension no earlier than 2027-01; no current move is expected before then.
